persistedQueryReceipts.scope: The anonymous AVSpec search interface explicitly searches published observations. Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. No automated provider-data request was sent. The official legacy HTTPS query form requires reCAPTCHA and says users needing more than 100 light curves should contact ASAS-SN. The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. CTAS therefore withholds automatic ingestion until ASAS-SN publishes a current secure, bounded machine-access contract. rules.position: Two positions with no stated uncertainty are inconsistent when they are more than 2 arcsec apart; when one states an error radius, the separation is compared with 3 times that radius.

rules.sigma: Two values that both state an uncertainty are inconsistent when they differ by more than 3 combined standard deviations (uncertainties added in quadrature; a stated position error radius is treated as one standard deviation).
